title.zh: 终端命令行与开发者环境出海代理设置：Git、Docker、NPM 与 Python pip 终极分流指南
title.en: Developer Terminal & CLI Proxy Handbook: Optimizing Git, Docker, NPM & Python Pip Routing

cluster.zh: TUN 虚拟网卡深度分流

description.zh: 专为程序员与技术研发团队定制的终端出海提速指南。一网打尽 PowerShell / Bash 环境变量注入、Git SSH 与 HTTPS 独立代理设置、Docker 镜像加速代理配置及 NPM / Pip 依赖极速拉取方案。
description.en: The definitive developer terminal networking handbook. Master environment variable injections for PowerShell and Bash, isolate Git HTTPS/SSH proxies, configure Docker daemon egress, and accelerate NPM and Pip package management.
